class.name: Simulation3D
class.brief_description: A container for a space and scenario, for use in [i]The Conservatory[/i].
class.description:
[Simulation3D] is a specialzied class designed explicitly for [i]The Conservatory[/i]. It is similar to [SubViewport] in that it has its own space and scenario (for physics and rendering respectively), but it is strictly controlled by the engine. All attempts to manage this object yourself will crash the game. You are expected to use its properties, and nothing more. The only class that can create new instances of this type is The Fabric of Reality.
This class cannot be used in [code]GDScript[/code].

method.name: get_is_live
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this instance is valid and can be used.

method.name: get_physics_space
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the physical space for this [Scenario3D]. Physical objects for this simulation should have their space set to this RID. [b]DANGER:[/b] Freeing this RID will crash the game.

method.name: get_render_scenario
method.description: Returns the [RID] of the render scenario for this [Scenario3D]. Rendered objects for this simulation should have their scenario set to this RID. [b]DANGER:[/b] Freeing this RID will crash the game.

method.name: destroy
method.description: Destroys this instance like [method Free], but validates that it is acceptable to do so. [b]DANGER:[/b] [i]Never[/i] [code]free()[/code] a [Simulation3D], or remove it as a child from the scene tree, or call this method without first destroying the corresponding [code]WorldInstance[/code] (a class in [i]The Conservatory[/i]). Failure to follow this warning will crash the game.

method.name: set_gravity
method.description: Sets the environmental gravity that this simulation will use. [b]This can only be used during construction. Attempting to call this after the simulation is live will crash the game.[/b]

method.name: set_conservatory_callbacks
method.description: [b]DANGER:[/b] This is strictly for internal use by [i]The Conservatory[/i]'s scene tree type, [i]The Fabric of Reality[/i]. Attempting to use this yourself will crash the game.

method.name: init_environment
method.description: Informs the simulation that it must change its current environment to the provided instance. [b]This can only be used during construction. Attempting to call this after the simulation is live will crash the game.[/b] [b]This instance is cloned when used. Modifying the original will not affect the simulation.[/b]

method.name: init_camera_attributes
method.description: Informs the simulation that it must change its current camera attributes to the provided instance. [b]This can only be used during construction. Attempting to call this after the simulation is live will crash the game.[/b] [b]This instance is cloned when used. Modifying the original will not affect the simulation.[/b]

method.name: init_compositor
method.description: Informs the simulation that it must change its current compositor to the provided instance. [b]This can only be used during construction. Attempting to call this after the simulation is live will crash the game.[/b] [b]This instance is cloned when used. Modifying the original will not affect the simulation.[/b]

method.name: get_environment
method.description: Returns the current internal [Environment] that the simulation is using. [b]Danger:[/b] Deleting this object before deleting the [Simulation3D] will crash the game.

method.name: get_camera_attributes
method.description: Returns the current internal [CameraAttributes] that the simulation is using. [b]Danger:[/b] Deleting this object before deleting the [Simulation3D] will crash the game.

method.name: get_compositor
method.description: Returns the current internal [Compositor] that the simulation is using. [b]Danger:[/b] Deleting this object before deleting the [Simulation3D] will crash the game.
